{"bugs_found":["seq() returns success([]) when BOTH parsers and kw_parsers are empty AND when only one is provided non-empty: 'if not parsers or not kw_parsers' is True whenever either is empty, so seq(p1, p2) returns success([]) instead of running the parsers — contract violation: seq must run parsers in order and collect results","ParseError.__str__ uses an f-string containing a single-quoted ', '.join(...) inside single-quoted f-string delimiters, which is a SyntaxError on Python <3.12 and breaks the documented Reporter/Parser contract of returning a formatted string","Parser.at_least(n) calls self.times(n) with a single argument, which sets max=min=n, so it parses exactly n then concatenates many() — but times(n) with exactly n required will succeed only if exactly n match, failing if more are available before backtracking; combined behavior diverges from 'at least n'","sep_by min=0 path: when min=0 it builds res = self.times(1) + (sep>>self).times(-1, max-1); times(-1, max-1) with negative min is not guarded and can misbehave","until() returns Result.success(index, values) without aggregating prior failure expectations, losing furthest-error info contract for aggregate behavior","should_fail returns Result.success(index, res) where res is a Result object rather than a meaningful value, but more importantly it discards aggregation of the inner failure's furthest info"],"verdict":"REQUEST_CHANGES"}
